title: 100% Uptime Guarantee
facebook_comment_text: That 10 minutes of downtime isn't just about lost revenue; it's about the erosion of customer trust and the unseen chaos for your engineering teams fixing critical data inconsistencies. 💡 Zero-trust containers don't just scale for traffic spikes, they ensure *secure*, rapid recovery. What's the biggest operational headache *your* team faces when an unexpected outage hits?
